summary: Materialise NV filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly progress under its share buyback program announced on 30 October 2025. The company repurchased 31,054 shares from 13–17 April 2026 at an average price of €4.45 per share, totaling €138,089. Since program inception on 26 January 2026, 576,583 shares (1% of outstanding) have been bought back for €2,593,856 under a discretionary mandate to an independent intermediary. The program authorizes up to €30 million in repurchases. This ordinary-course buyback is a capital return to shareholders, not a tender offer or structural change.
